name: Arab League

flag.description: A green field with a white emblem in the centre: an upturned crescent beneath the Arabic name of the League, inside a gold chain and a white laurel wreath.
flag.symbolism: The chain stands for the unity of the member states and the wreath for peace; green is a colour long associated with Islam and the Arab world.

hook: The Arab League is green with a white crescent, chain and laurel wreath around Arabic script; Saudi Arabia's green has its script above a sword and no wreath.
trivia: The League was founded in Cairo on 22 March 1945 by seven states: Egypt, Iraq, Transjordan, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Syria and Yemen.
Syria's membership was suspended in 2011 and restored in 2023.
